subject: NimbusGuard Vendr onboarding + presign window coordination
thread_summary: Vendor (NimbusGuard) requested Vendr profile onboarding and a short presign upload window. Internal team assigned evidence owner, provided SIG worksheet and presign instructions, and scheduled a temporary service account for uploads.
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbusguard.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding request + short presign window

Hi Irene / Ben,

We're getting ready to complete our Vendr profile for Redwood's vendor intake. Security team asked if we can be onboarded into your Vendr account and offered a short presign upload window next week. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm the primary contact for evidence uploads; 2) do you have a recommended presign window (we can be flexible but prefer a 48–72 hour window)?

We will provide our SOC 2 report, CAIQ export, and a short KMS audit snippet. If there are any templated worksheets you prefer we fill first, please pass them along.

Link to your Vendr invite we received: https://app.vendr.com/nimbusguard/onboard

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Security Ops | NimbusGuard
[Attachment: none]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbusguard.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding request + short presign window

Hi Daniel —

Welcome — copying Ben (evidence lead) and Marissa (portal ops) to coordinate. Ben will own the SIG/CAIQ mapping; Marissa will coordinate the presign window and temporary upload credentials.

I attached a small SIG worksheet we use to map short answers and highlight critical evidence we need (SOC2, networking/KMS screenshots, IAM policy snippets). Please fill what you can; we can take the CAIQ export directly if you have it.

Proposed next steps:
- Daniel: upload CAIQ export or fill attached SIG-worksheet.xlsx
- Ben: we will review and flag missing artifacts
- Marissa: propose and schedule presign window

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SIG-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbusguard.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding request + short presign window

Thanks Daniel — short checklist and proposed timetable below.

Checklist (what we need to ingest into Vendr/Whistic):
- CAIQ export (preferred) or completed SIG worksheet
- Latest SOC 2 report (pdf) + monitoring attest date
- KMS key policy screenshot and rotation cadence statement
- S3 bucket policy or dataflow diagram for any customer data buckets
- Contact for upload SFTP/service-account (we can provide temporary creds)

Proposed presign window: May 10 09:00 PT -> May 12 17:00 PT (48–56 hour window). If that doesn't work for you let us know a couple alternatives.

Upload options and links: we can accept uploads via the Vendr presign portal (https://app.vendr.com/nimbusguard/onboard) or we can provision a temporary service account and dropbox (preferred for large artifacts). Once you confirm, Marissa will send the presign-instructions.pdf with step-by-step presign URLs and credential TTLs.

Action owner mapping:
- Daniel: confirm presign window & chosen upload method + initial CAIQ/SOC2
- Ben: perform artifact QC and flag follow-ups
- Marissa: create service account + send presign-instructions

Ben Carter
Security Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: presign-instructions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbusguard.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding request + short presign window

Ben / Irene / Marissa —

Thanks. May 10–12 works for us. We'll plan to upload the CAIQ export and SOC2 pdf during the first day and follow up with the KMS audit snippet the morning of May 11. For the upload method we prefer the temporary service account you mentioned.

I've attached a brief upload inventory (expected files and approximate sizes). Please go ahead and provision the upload creds; we need a minimum 72-hour TTL to finish validation internally.

Cheers,
Daniel Park
Security Ops | NimbusGuard
[Attachment: upload-inventory.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbusguard.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding request + short presign window

Daniel —

We will provision a temporary service account and send credentials via the Vendr presign portal on May 10 at 08:45 PT. Credentials will have a 96-hour TTL and forced rotation after first use (we require rotation for large archives). Please follow the presign-instructions.pdf for presigned PUT URLs; note that we also enforce a max file size of 250MB per object and prefer zipped bundles for larger collections.

Action items:
- Redwood: create temp service account + presign list (Marissa)
- NimbusGuard: upload CAIQ export + SOC2 on May 10 morning
- Ben: QC artifacts and confirm SOC2 summary by EOD May 11

I'll send the presign link and a drive-of-record for any files that exceed the single-object limit. See you in the presign window.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
